sentences.text:
Hemu @ Hemraj Adiwasi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11
November, 2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Gwl:19532
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 11th Of November, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 45643 of 2024
 Hemu @ Hemraj Adiwasi
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Sooraj Bhan Lodhi - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri Samar Ghuraiya - Public Prosecutor for the State
 Order

This is the fourth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS for grant of bail relating to Crime No.376/2023 registered at Police Station Khaniyadhana District Shivpuri (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376 and 450 of IPC.

The earlier (third) bail application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 30.08.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.18303/2024.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

It is submitted that first bail application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 29.11.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.41903/2023 with liberty to renew the prayer after examination of complainant and eye witnesses Aman and Rahul.

The second bail application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 22.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.2341/2024 with liberty to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19532 2 MCRC-45643-2024 renew the prayer after the complainant is examined.

Thereafter, third bail application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 30.08.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.18303/2024.

It is submitted that the independent witnesses Rahul (PW-1) and Aman (PW-2)
have been examined and they have turned hostile.
They did not support the story of prosecution.
The prosecutrix has also been examined on 18.07.2024.
She has supported the story of prosecution but thereafter, the DNA report has been received which is negative against the applicant.

Therefore,
in the light of DNA report, applicant has filed this fourth bail application.
Applicant is in custody since 11.08.2023.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application on the ground that there is no change in circumstances after dismissal of third bail application as the statements of aforesaid witnesses had taken before the dismissal of third bail application, even the prosecutrix was examined on 18.07.2024 and as far as the FSL report is concerned, the report is having date 01.04.2024 i.e. it is prior to dismissal of first bail application; therefore, he prays for dismissal of this bail application.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties perusal of case diary, it is found that third bail application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 30.08.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.18303/2024 and the FSL report which has been filed by learned counsel for applicant is having date 01.04.2024 and there is no evidence as regard the submission of this report after the dismissal of third bail application.

Therefore, considering the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-GWL:19532 3 MCRC-45643-2024 totality of facts and circumstances of the case and the allegations made against the applicant and that there is no change in circumstances after dismissal of third bail application, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that no case for grant of bail to the applicant is made out at this stage.
Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE Aman Hemu @ Hemraj Adiwasi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182020992/
